Carregamento de Pacotes)

```{python}
import polars as pl
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
```

1\)

```{python}
basics_path = "Dados/title.basics0.tsv.gz"
ratings_path = "Dados/title.ratings.tsv.gz"
principals_path = "Dados/title.principals0.tsv.gz"

def load_and_write_in_chunks(path, table_name, conn, chunk_size=100_000):
    """
    Lê um TSV em blocos usando BatchedCsvReader.next_batches()
    e grava no SQLite em partes, evitando estouro de memória.
    """
    print(f"Carregando {table_name} em chunks de {chunk_size} linhas...")
    
    reader = pl.read_csv_batched(
        path,
        separator="\t",
        null_values="\\N",
        infer_schema_length=0,
        quote_char=None,
        batch_size=chunk_size)

    first = True
    while True:
        batches = reader.next_batches(1)   
        if not batches:
            break
        batch = batches[0]
        pdf = batch.to_pandas()
        pdf.to_sql(
            table_name,
            conn,
            if_exists="replace" if first else "append",
            index=False)
        first = False
    print(f"Tabela {table_name} carregada com sucesso!")

conn = sqlite3.connect("imdb.sqlite")

load_and_write_in_chunks(basics_path, "basics", conn)
load_and_write_in_chunks(ratings_path, "ratings", conn)
load_and_write_in_chunks(principals_path, "principals", conn)

tables = conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';").fetchall()
print("Tabelas no banco:", tables)

conn.commit()
```

2\)

```{python}
query_top5 = """
SELECT 
    b.primaryTitle,
    r.averageRating,
    r.numVotes
FROM basics b
JOIN ratings r ON b.tconst = r.tconst
WHERE b.titleType = 'movie'
ORDER BY r.averageRating DESC, r.numVotes DESC
LIMIT 5;
"""

top5 = pl.read_database(query_top5, connection=conn)
print("🎬 Top 5 filmes com maiores notas:")
print(top5)
```

3\)

```{python}
query_genre = """
WITH high_rated AS (
    SELECT b.genres
    FROM basics b
    JOIN ratings r ON b.tconst = r.tconst
    WHERE b.titleType = 'movie'
      AND r.averageRating > 8
      AND b.genres IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT TRIM(value) AS genre, COUNT(*) AS freq
FROM high_rated, 
     json_each('["' || REPLACE(genres, ',', '","') || '"]')
GROUP BY genre
ORDER BY freq DESC
LIMIT 1;
"""

genre_top = pl.read_database(query_genre, connection=conn)
print("🏆 Gênero mais frequente entre filmes com nota > 8:")
print(genre_top)
```

4\)

```{python}
query_actors = """
SELECT 
    p.nconst,
    COUNT(*) AS total_filmes
FROM principals p
JOIN ratings r ON p.tconst = r.tconst
JOIN basics b ON p.tconst = b.tconst
WHERE b.titleType = 'movie'
  AND r.averageRating > 7.5
  AND p.category IN ('actor', 'actress')
GROUP BY p.nconst
ORDER BY total_filmes DESC
LIMIT 3;
"""

top_actors = pl.read_database(query_actors, connection=conn)
print("👑 Top 3 atores/atrizes em filmes com nota > 7.5:")
print(top_actors)
```
